blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Coronary guidewire navigation during percutaneous coronary intervention requires continuous interpretation of vessel anatomy, guidewire position, and target stenosis under two-dimensional X-ray fluoroscopy. While existing approaches commonly address vessel segmentation or device localization as separate tasks, a robotic system requires a more structured perception of the coronary scene to support downstream navigation. In this work, we present a simulation-driven framework centered on a Multi-Task Coronary Perception Network (MCP-Net) for robotic guidewire navigation, integrating coronary vessel segmentation, vascular topology extraction, and roadmap generation. Starting from three-dimensional coronary CT angiography, we generate simulated fluoroscopy images containing vascular structures, simulated guidewires, stenotic lesions with varying severity, and diverse vascular geometries, together with simulation-derived ground truth. MCP-Net jointly performs coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization from a single fluoroscopic frame. These predictions are subsequently converted into a structured vascular graph containing centerlines, bifurcations, endpoints, branch directions, and branch angles. By associating the predicted stenosis with this graph, the framework generates a roadmap from the automatically selected graph root toward the target lesion. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework can jointly recover coronary perception targets and transform them into an interpretable vascular representation suitable for downstream robotic navigation.
blocks.zh: 近冠干扰期间的冠状导线导航需要在二维X射线含氟镜下持续地解释舰体解剖,导线位置,以及目标快感. 虽然现有方法通常将船舶分出或装置定位作为单独的任务处理,但机器人系统需要对冠状场景有更有组织的感知,以支持下游通航. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了一个模拟驱动的框架,其中心是机器人导线导航的多任务冕能感网络(MCP-Net),其中结合了冠状舰船分解,血管地貌提取和路线图生成. 从三维冠状CT血管造影学开始,我们生成含血管结构、模拟导线、不同严重程度的快感损伤、多种血管几何等模拟成像以及模拟产生的地面真象。 MCP-Net联合进行冠状船分化、导线-尖端本地化以及从单一氟化框架进行快感本地化。 这些预测随后被转换为结构化的血管图,包含中线,双线,端点,分支方向和分支角度. 框架通过将预测的快感与这个图表联系起来,从自动选定的图表根生成一个行进图去向目标损伤. 结果显示,拟议框架可以联合恢复冠状感知目标,并把它们转化为适合下游机器人导航的可解释血管表现.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Coronary artery disease remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, and percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is one of the primary procedures used to restore blood flow through stenotic coronary arteries [ 1 , 2 ] . During PCI, the interventionalist must advance a thin guidewire through a complex, branching coronary vasculature toward the target lesion under two-dimensional X-ray fluoroscopic guidance. This task requires continuous interpretation of vessel geometry, identification of the lesion, and selection of the appropriate branch at successive bifurcations. The difficulty is compounded by vessel overlap, low image contrast, respiratory and cardiac motion, and the loss of depth information inherent to projection imaging [ 3 , 4 ] . These challenges have also motivated the development of robotic-assisted PCI (RA-PCI), which enables remote manipulation of coronary guidewires and devices and has demonstrated clinical feasibility while reducing operator radiation exposure [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . However, increasing the level of robotic assistance requires reliable intraoperative perception capable of extracting actionable vascular information directly from fluoroscopic images.
blocks.zh: 冠状动脉疾病仍然是全世界发病和死亡的主要原因,而皮下冠状动脉干预(PCI)是用于通过心动动动脉恢复血液流动的主要程序之一[1,2]. 在PCI期间,干预者必须在二维X射线氟镜下,通过一个复杂的、分支性冠状血管向目标损伤推进一根薄导线。 这项任务需要不断解释船只几何特征,鉴定损伤,并在接连的两侧选择适当的分支。 由于容器重叠、图像对比度低、呼吸和心脏运动以及投影成像所固有的深度信息损失[3、4],使困难更加严重。 这些挑战还推动了机器人辅助PCI(RA-PCI)的发展,从而能够远程操纵冠状导线和装置,并证明了临床可行性,同时减少了操作员的辐射照射[5,6,7]. 然而,提高机器人协助水平需要可靠的内操作感知,能够直接从荧光图像中提取可动血管信息。

blocks.en: For robotic guidewire navigation, however, vessel segmentation alone is not sufficient. A navigation system must reason about both the device and its surrounding anatomy: where the guidewire tip is located, where the target stenosis lies, how the coronary tree branches, and which sequence of vessel segments connects the coronary root to the target. Such information must also be available at interactive rates if it is to support intraoperative robotic decision-making. Existing work has investigated coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire or catheter localization, and vascular analysis [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , but these components are commonly considered as separate problems. Consequently, even an accurate segmentation mask does not directly provide the structured anatomical representation required for downstream navigation, including vessel connectivity, bifurcation structure, branch orientation, and a path toward the target lesion.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于机器人导线导航来说,光靠船只分割是不够的。 导航系统必须说明设备及其周围解剖学的原因:导线尖端的位置,目标激素位置,冠状树枝如何,以及哪个船段的序列将冠状树根与目标连接起来. 如果要支持操作内机器人决策,这种信息也必须以互动的速度提供。 现有工作研究了冠状船体分化,导线或导管局部化,血管分析[8,9,10],但这些成分通常被认为是单独的问题. 因此,即使是精确的分块遮罩也不能直接提供下游航行所需的结构解剖表示,包括船只连接、双层结构、分支方向和通往目标损伤的路径。

blocks.en: A second challenge is the availability of suitable training and evaluation data. Dense annotation of coronary fluoroscopy is difficult and time-consuming, particularly for thin or overlapping vessels. Precise annotation of guidewire tips, stenosis location, and stenosis severity introduces additional ambiguity, while annotations of centerlines and vascular topology require further expert effort. More importantly, the ground-truth geometry underlying a two-dimensional projection is generally unavailable in real fluoroscopic data. These limitations make it difficult to jointly train and quantitatively evaluate all of the perception and geometric components required by a robotic navigation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 第二个挑战是能否获得适当的培训和评价数据。 冠状氟化物的注释很困难,很费时,特别是对于薄薄或重叠的船只。 对导线提示的精确说明、快感位置和快感严重性增加了模糊性,而对中心线和血管地形的说明则需要进一步的专家努力。 更为重要的是,在真实的含氟度数据中,一般无法掌握二维投影的地真几何。 由于这些限制,很难联合培训和定量评估机器人导航管道所需的所有感知和几何组件。

blocks.en: In this work, we address these challenges through a simulation-driven, multi-task framework for coronary perception, topological analysis, and real-time roadmap generation. Starting from three-dimensional coronary CT angiography, we generate fluoroscopy-like projections containing coronary vessels, simulated guidewires, and stenotic lesions with different severity levels across diverse vascular geometries. Since the underlying scene geometry is known, task-specific ground truth can be generated automatically for vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, stenosis localization, and geometric analysis. These data are used to train the proposed Multi-Task Coronary Perception Network (MCP-Net), which jointly predicts the vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis landmarks from a single fluoroscopy frame. The predicted vasculature is subsequently converted into a structured centerline graph containing bifurcations, endpoints, vessel geometry, and branch information, from which a target-oriented vascular roadmap is generated.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过模拟驱动的多任务框架来应对这些挑战,该框架用于冠状感知、地形分析和实时路线图生成。 从三维冠状CT血管造影学开始, 我们生成类似氟镜的预测 包含冠状血管, 模拟导线, 以及不同血管几何的 不同严重程度的神经损伤。 由于基础场景几何是已知的,因此任务特定的地面真理可以自动生成,用于舰船分割,导线-尖端局部化,速成局部化,几何分析. 这些数据用于培训拟议中的多任务冠冕感官网络(MCP-Net),该网络联合预测了船只的面具,导线-提示位置,以及单氟镜框的速成地标. 预测的挥发物随后被转换成结构化的中线图,其中包含双鱼座,端点,船体几何,分支信息,从中生成面向目标的血管路线图.

blocks.en: This design deliberately separates learned image perception from geometric vascular reasoning. MCP-Net performs the image-dependent tasks jointly in a single forward pass, while centerline extraction, graph construction, and roadmap generation operate directly on the resulting vascular representation. The combination provides not only pixel-level predictions, but also a compact and interpretable description of the coronary anatomy that can serve as a perception interface for downstream robotic planning.
blocks.zh: 这种设计刻意将所学的图像感知与几何血管推理区分开来. MCP-Net在一个单一的前进通道中共同执行依赖图像的任务,而中线提取、图建和路线图生成则直接在由此产生的血管表现上运行。 该组合不仅提供了像素水平的预测,还提供了对冠状解剖学的紧凑和可解释的描述,可以作为下游机器人规划的感知界面.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: • We develop a CT-based coronary fluoroscopy simulation framework that generates synthetic intervention scenes containing coronary vasculature, simulated guidewires, and stenotic lesions with varying severity, together with automatically generated task-specific ground truth. • We propose MCP-Net, a multi-task coronary perception network that jointly performs coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization within a unified architecture. • We introduce a real-time vascular topology and roadmap generation framework that converts the predicted vasculature into a structured graph containing centerlines, vessel calibers, bifurcations, endpoints, and branch geometry, and generates a navigation-oriented path toward the detected stenosis. • We provide a comprehensive evaluation on the simulated fluoroscopy dataset, including comparisons with established segmentation architectures, vessel segmentation and connectivity, guidewire-tip and stenosis localization, lesion geometry, vascular topology, roadmap generation, and end-to-end computational performance.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是: 我们开发了一个基于CT的冠状含氟镜仿真框架,生成含有冠状花纹的合成干涉场景,模拟导线,以及不同程度的快感损伤,以及自动生成的任务特定的地面真伪. 我们提议使用MCP-Net,这是一个多任务冠状感知网络,在统一的架构内联合进行冠状舰船区划,导线-尖端局部化,定点化. 我们引入了实时血管地形学和路线图生成框架,将预测的脉冲转化为一个结构化的图表,其中包含中心线,容器口径,双叶线,端点,和分支几何,并生成一条面向导航的通向检测到的振荡路径. ^ 我们对模拟的氟化物数据集进行综合评价,包括与既定分块结构、船体分块和连通性、导线-尖端和快感定位、损伤几何学、血管地形学、路线图生成和端到端的计算性能进行比较。

blocks.en: We develop a CT-based coronary fluoroscopy simulation framework that generates synthetic intervention scenes containing coronary vasculature, simulated guidewires, and stenotic lesions with varying severity, together with automatically generated task-specific ground truth.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个基于CT的冠状氟体镜仿真框架,生成包含冠状花纹的合成干涉场景,模拟导线,以及不同严重程度的快感损伤,以及自动生成的任务特定的地面真伪.

blocks.en: We propose MCP-Net, a multi-task coronary perception network that jointly performs coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization within a unified architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MCP-Net,一个多任务冠状感知网络,在一个统一的架构内,联合进行冠状舰船区划,导线-尖端本地化,定点化.

blocks.en: We introduce a real-time vascular topology and roadmap generation framework that converts the predicted vasculature into a structured graph containing centerlines, vessel calibers, bifurcations, endpoints, and branch geometry, and generates a navigation-oriented path toward the detected stenosis.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个实时血管地形学和路线图生成框架, 将预测的脉冲转换成一个结构化的图表, 包含中心线, 船口径, 双联,端点, 和分支几何, 并产生一条面向导航的路径, 通往检测到的脉冲。

blocks.en: We provide a comprehensive evaluation on the simulated fluoroscopy dataset, including comparisons with established segmentation architectures, vessel segmentation and connectivity, guidewire-tip and stenosis localization, lesion geometry, vascular topology, roadmap generation, and end-to-end computational performance.
blocks.zh: 我们对模拟的氟化物数据集进行综合评价,包括与既定分块结构、船体分块和连通性、导线-尖端和快感定位、损伤几何学、血管地形学、路线图生成和端到端的计算性能进行比较。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work, and Section III presents the proposed framework. Sections IV and V describe the experimental setup and results, respectively. Section VI discusses the findings, limitations, and future directions, and Section VII concludes the paper.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查有关工作,第三节提出拟议框架。 第四和第五节分别描述了实验设置和结果. 第六节讨论结论、局限性和未来方向,第七节结束本文件。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Coronary Vessel Segmentation in X-ray Angiography
blocks.zh: X射线血管造影术中的冠状船分离

blocks.en: Deep learning has substantially improved coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography, with recent work focusing on vessel continuity, temporal information, and reducing dependence on manual annotations. He et al. proposed TVS-Net, which incorporates temporal information from angiographic sequences together with a connectivity-preserving objective [ 3 ] . Li et al. further introduced a subpixel-level framework for X-ray coronary angiography, combining vessel landmark localization with topology-aware contour estimation for quantitative vessel analysis [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 深入学习大大改善了X射线血管学中的冠状血管分化,最近的工作重点是船只的连续性、时间信息以及减少对人工说明的依赖。 他等人提出了TVS-Net,其中纳入了来自血管测序的时间信息以及一个连接-保留目标[3]。 李等编. 进一步引入了X射线冠状血管造影的子像素级框架,结合了船只地标定位和地形感知轮廓估计,用于定量船只分析[11].

blocks.en: The difficulty of obtaining dense annotations from clinical angiography has also motivated simulation- and self-supervision-based approaches. Zhang et al. used digitally reconstructed radiographs generated from CT data together with domain randomization and self-supervised learning to train coronary vessel segmentation without manual angiographic annotations [ 12 ] . More recently, XA-Sim2Real generates simulated X-ray angiograms from coronary CT angiography and learns adaptive representations between simulated and real images [ 13 ] . These approaches demonstrate the value of CT-derived supervision, but primarily target vessel segmentation. In contrast, our simulation pipeline additionally models the interventional guidewire and stenotic lesion, providing simulation-derived supervision for multiple perception tasks and subsequent vascular topology analysis.
blocks.zh: 从临床血管造影学中获取密集说明的难度也激发了模拟和自我监督的方法. 张等人使用数字化重建的由CT数据生成的射电图,加上域随机化和自我监督的学习,在没有人工血管学说明的情况下训练冠状舰船分区[12]. 最近,XA-Sim2Real从冠状CT血管学中生成模拟X射线血管图,并学习模拟图像与真实图像之间的适应性表达[13]. 这些方法显示了CT衍生监督的价值,但主要是针对船只的分解。 与此相反,我们的模拟管道还模拟了干预导线和速效损伤,为多重感知任务提供模拟产生的监督,以及随后的血管地形分析。

blocks.en: II-B Guidewire and Lesion Localization
blocks.zh: II-B 导游和Lesion 本地化

blocks.en: Reliable localization of interventional devices is another important component of image-guided vascular procedures. Zhang et al. proposed a two-stage real-time framework for guidewire tracking and segmentation in intraoperative X-ray images using spatial-temporal refinement and guidewire-specific feature enhancement [ 14 ] . Yao et al. subsequently introduced a Siamese attention network for real-time guidewire-tip tracking [ 15 ] . Recent work by Robertshaw et al. integrated catheter/guidewire segmentation, skeletonization, and tip extraction into a real-time fluoroscopic tracking pipeline intended for downstream autonomous navigation [ 16 ] . Multi-task learning has also been explored for interventional device perception; Xi et al. jointly performed catheter segmentation and electrode localization using a shared network with multiple prediction heads [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 干预装置的可靠本地化是图像导导血管程序的另一个重要组成部分. 张某等人提出,采用空间时空精细化和导线专用特性增强法,在操作中的X射线影像中进行导线跟踪和分化的两级实时框架[14]. 姚等编. 随后引入了暹罗关注网络,用于实时导线-提示跟踪[15]. Robertshaw等人最近的工作,综合导管/导线分离、骨架化和尖端抽取进入一个实时氟化物跟踪管道,用于下游自主导航[16]。 也探索了多任务学习的干预设备感知;习近平等人联合进行导管分解和电极局部化,使用共享网络,多预测头[17].

blocks.en: Stenosis detection has largely been studied separately from device perception. DeepCoro employs vessel tracking and video-based models for automatic localization and assessment of coronary stenoses [ 18 ] , while Molenaar et al. recently developed and externally validated deep-learning models for both coronary artery segmentation and significant stenosis detection in invasive coronary angiography [ 4 ] . In contrast to these task-specific or paired formulations, MCP-Net jointly estimates the coronary vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis location from a single fluoroscopy frame using a shared representation.
blocks.zh: 激素检测与设备感知基本分开研究. DeepCoro使用船只跟踪和基于视频的模型来自动定位和评估冠状激素[18],而Molenaar等人则使用. 最近开发并对外验证的冠状动脉分解和侵入性冠状血管造影学中显著速成检测的深度学习模型[4]. 与这些特定任务或配对配方不同,MCP-Net通过共享的表示法,共同从一个单一的氟镜框估算冠状容器罩,导线-尖端位置和速成位置.

blocks.en: II-C Vascular Topology and Robotic Endovascular Navigation
blocks.zh: II-C 广域地形学和机器人内血管导航

blocks.en: Beyond pixel-level segmentation, structured vascular representations are important for anatomical reasoning and robotic navigation. Hampe et al. represented coronary artery trees as graphs for automatic extraction and anatomical labeling in coronary CT angiography [ 19 ] . Such centerline- and graph-based representations provide explicit information about vessel connectivity and branching structure that is not directly available from a binary segmentation mask.
blocks.zh: 除了像素层面的分割外,结构化的血管表达对于解剖推理和机器人导航也非常重要. 汉姆佩等人. 代表冠状动脉树,作为冠状CT血管学中自动提取和解剖标签的图表[19]. 这种以中线和图表为基础的表述提供了二元分解罩无法直接获取的船舶连接和分支结构的明确信息。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed framework. Coronary CT angiography is used to generate simulated fluoroscopy images and task-specific annotations for MCP-Net training. During real-time inference, the trained MCP-Net jointly predicts the vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis landmarks from a single fluoroscopy frame. The predicted vasculature is converted into a structured centerline graph and combined with the predicted stenosis target to generate a navigation-oriented roadmap.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1. 拟议框架概览。 冠状CT血管造影法用于生成模拟的氟镜成像和MCP-Net训练任务专用说明. 在实时推导期间,经过培训的MCP-Net联合预测了船面罩,导线-尖端位置,以及单氟镜框的速成地标. 预测的花纹被转换成结构化的中线图,并与预测的速成目标结合,生成面向导航的路线图.

blocks.en: In robotic endovascular intervention, Li et al. proposed a vascular centerline-guided autonomous navigation method, demonstrating the utility of centerline geometry for robot-assisted navigation [ 20 ] . Scarponi et al. further investigated reinforcement learning for autonomous guidewire navigation in unseen vascular geometries [ 21 ] and extended this direction to deforming anatomy under single-view fluoroscopic imaging [ 22 ] . These works highlight the importance of reliable geometric and device state information for robotic navigation. Our work focuses on producing such information directly from fluoroscopic perception: the predicted vessel mask is converted into a structured graph containing centerlines, bifurcations, endpoints, vessel calibers, and branch geometry, from which a root-to-lesion roadmap is derived.
blocks.zh: 在机器人内血管干预中,李等人提出了血管中线导引自主导航方法,展示了中心线几何对机器人辅助导航的实用性[20]. Scarponi等人进一步调查了在未见血管几何中进行自主导线导航的强化学习[21],并将这一方向扩大到在单视氟成像下变形解剖[22]. 这些作品突出了可靠的几何和装置状态信息对于机器人导航的重要性. 我们的工作重点是直接从氟化物感知中生成此类信息:预测的容器罩被转换成一个结构化的图表,其中包含中线、双叶线、端点、容器口径和分支几何,从中可以得出根对液的路线图。

blocks.en: III Methods
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en:
The proposed framework consists of an offline simulation and training stage followed by a real-time perception and vascular-analysis pipeline, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . First, simulated fluoroscopy images and their task-specific annotations are generated from coronary CT angiography (Section III-A) and used to train MCP-Net. During real-time inference, the trained MCP-Net processes each incoming fluoroscopy frame in a single forward pass to predict the coronary vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis landmarks (Section III-B). The predicted vessel mask is subsequently converted into a centerline-based vascular graph containing topological and geometric information (Section III-C). The graph is then combined with the localized target to generate a navigation-oriented roadmap toward the stenosis (Section III-D). Section III-E summarizes the complete
real-time inference pipeline.
blocks.zh:
如图所示,拟议框架包括离线模拟和培训阶段,然后是实时感知和血管分析管道。 1 (英语). 首先,模拟的氟镜镜像及其特定任务说明来自冠状CT血管造影(第三节A),并用于培训MCP-Net. 在实时推论中,经过训练的MCP-Net处理每个进场的氟镜镜框在一个单前传中,以预测冠状船面罩,导线-提示位置,以及速成标志(第三节B). 预测的容器掩体随后被转换为包含地形和几何信息的中线血管图(第三节-C节)。 然后,该图与局部目标相结合,以生成面向导航的快速化路线图(第三节D)。 第三至E节概述
实时推导管道。

blocks.en: III-A Data Simulation
blocks.zh: III-A 数据模拟

blocks.en: Real fluoroscopy with dense, per-pixel and per-point annotations is scarce and impractical to label by hand. We therefore synthesize training data from three-dimensional coronary CT angiography [ 23 ] . For each CT volume, multiple two-dimensional fluoroscopy-like projections are generated using Tomosipo [ 24 ] , with the underlying projection operations performed by the ASTRA Toolbox [ 25 ] . Vessel centerlines and local radius profiles are extracted using the Vascular Modeling Toolkit (VMTK) [ 26 ] . Stenotic lesions are simulated by locally reducing the vessel radius along a selected centerline segment, allowing lesions with different severity levels and locations to be generated. A simulated guidewire is subsequently introduced and advanced toward the stenotic region using the coronary centerline as a geometric reference. Because the underlying anatomy and simulated intervention components are known, exact simulation-derived annotations can be generated automatically for each projection. These include the coronary vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis landmarks, together with additional geometric information required for downstream analysis. This simulation stage is performed offline and provides the dataset used to train MCP-Net and evaluate the complete framework.
blocks.zh: 真实的含浓,每像素和每点注解的氟化物很少,不切实际的用手贴标签. 因此,我们综合了三维冠状CT血管学的训练数据[23]. 对于每个CT体积,使用Tomosipo[24]生成多个二维荧光学类预测,其基础投影操作由ASTRA工具箱[25]. 利用 " VMTK " 模型工具箱(VMTK)提取船只中心线和当地半径剖面图[26]。 通过局部减少船只沿选定的中线部分的半径来模拟轻度损伤,从而产生不同严重程度和地点的损伤。 随后采用了模拟导线,并以冠状中线作为几何参考,向速成区推进。 由于基础解剖学和模拟干预组件是已知的,因此每个投影都可以自动生成精确的模拟衍生说明. 其中包括冠状船面罩、导线-尖端位置和速成地标,以及下游分析所需的更多几何信息。 这个模拟阶段是离线进行的,并提供用于培训MCP-Net和评价完整框架的数据集.

blocks.en: III-B Multi-Task Coronary Perception Network (MCP-Net)
blocks.zh: III-B 多任务冕膜感知网(MCP-Net)

blocks.en: Given a single fluoroscopy frame I I , MCP-Net jointly predicts the coronary vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis landmarks. A shared feature representation is followed by three task-specific prediction heads for vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization. The vessel branch employs a DeepLabV3+ decoder with atrous spatial pyramid pooling (ASPP) to produce a dense binary coronary segmentation. The vessel branch is optimized using the combination of binary cross-entropy and Dice losses,
blocks.zh: MCP-Net联合预测了冠状船罩、导线-尖端位置和速成地标。 共同的特色表现之后是三个任务特定的预测头,分别用于船舶分割、导线-提示本地化和定点化。 该船支部使用带有原子空间金字塔集合(ASPP)的DeepLabV3+解码器来产生密集的二元冠片段. 舰只分支利用二进制横纹和Dice损耗的组合优化,

blocks.zh: 它平衡了像素类分类与区域重叠,非常适合稀疏,薄的船体结构.

The guidewire branch predicts a single tip location, whereas the stenosis branch predicts three landmarks corresponding to the proximal boundary, lesion throat, and distal boundary, thereby representing both the location and extent of the stenosis. Localization losses are applied only to valid annotated targets.

At run time, only the trained MCP-Net checkpoint is used, and all three perception outputs are obtained in a single forward pass.

blocks.en: III-C Vascular Topology and Geometric Analysis
blocks.zh: III-C 广域地形学和几何分析

blocks.en: The predicted vessel mask is converted into a structured vascular representation using deterministic geometric processing. Small disconnected components are first removed, after which morphological skeletonization reduces the vessel tree to a one-pixel-wide centerline. A Euclidean distance transform of the binary vessel mask is used to estimate the local vessel caliber. For a centerline point 𝐩 \mathbf{p} , the local diameter is defined as

blocks.en: The extracted centerline is subsequently converted into a vascular graph 𝒢 = ( 𝒱 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}) . Graph nodes represent vessel bifurcations and terminal endpoints, while edges correspond to the centerline segments connecting them. Each edge retains its centerline trajectory together with geometric attributes including segment length and local vessel diameter. Short spurious segments are removed and nearby junctions are consolidated to reduce artifacts introduced by discrete skeletonization.
blocks.zh: 提取的中线随后被转换成血管图G=(V,E)\mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}). 图形节点代表船体双裂和终端端点,边缘则对应连接它们的中线段. 每个边缘保留其中心线轨迹,并带有几何属性,包括段长和局部容器直径. 短假片段被移除,附近路口被整合,以减少离散骨架化引入的文物.

blocks.en: Local vessel directions are estimated from the centerline geometry around each junction and are used to compute bifurcation and take-off angles. The resulting graph therefore captures both the connectivity and local geometry of the predicted coronary tree and provides the structured representation required for subsequent landmark association and roadmap generation.
blocks.zh: 局部船只方向从每个交叉口周围的中线几何线来估计,用来计算双福和起飞角度. 因此,由此产生的图表既能捕捉到预测的冠状树的连通性和局部几何性,又能提供随后具有里程碑意义的关联和路线图生成所需的结构化代表.

blocks.en: III-D Roadmap Generation
blocks.zh: 三-D 路线图生成

blocks.en: The vascular graph and predicted stenosis location are combined to construct an automatic navigation roadmap toward the target lesion. The start point is defined by the automatically selected graph root, which serves as a proxy for the coronary ostium, while the predicted stenosis throat defines the target.
blocks.zh: 血管图和预测的性激素位置结合,为目标损伤构建自动导航路线图. 起始点由自动选择的图根来定义,它作为冠状 o的代名词,而预测的激素咽喉则定义目标.

blocks.en: Both locations are projected onto the nearest vessel centerline points. If either lies within a graph edge, a temporary node is inserted at the projected location to preserve the exact start and end positions. A shortest-path search is then performed using vessel-segment arc length as the edge weight, producing a continuous centerline path from the root to the stenosis.
blocks.zh: 这两个地点预计都位于最近的船舶中线点。 如果位于图边,则在预测地点插入一个临时节点,以保留确切的起始和结束位置。 然后用船体分界弧长度作为边重进行最短的路径搜索,产生从根到齿轮的连续中线路径.

blocks.en: Along the resulting path, traversed bifurcations are identified and local vessel directions are used to compute branch angles and classify each navigation decision as left, right, or straight. The resulting roadmap therefore provides both the target-oriented vessel path and bifurcation-level navigation cues for downstream robotic planning or guidewire control.
blocks.zh: 沿由此形成的路径,识别出横贯的双鱼座,并使用局部的船身方向来计算分支角度,并将每个航行决定分为左,右,或直. 因此,由此产生的路线图为下游机器人规划或导线控制提供了面向目标的船只路径和双层导航提示。

blocks.en: III-E Real-Time Inference
blocks.zh: 三-E 实时推论

blocks.en: During online operation, each fluoroscopy frame is processed by the trained MCP-Net in a single forward pass to obtain the vessel mask, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis location.
blocks.zh: 在在线操作期间,每个荧光镜框都由经过培训的MCP-Net以单一前传通道进行处理,以获得船面罩、导线-提示位置和速效位置。

blocks.en: The predicted vessel mask is then converted into a centerline-based vascular graph containing the root, bifurcations, endpoints, vessel calibers, and branch geometry. The predicted stenosis throat is associated with this graph, and the roadmap-generation procedure in Section III-D is applied automatically.
blocks.zh: 然后将预测的容器遮罩转换成以中线为基础的血管图,包含根,双叶,端点,容器口径,以及分支几何. 预言性激素咽喉与本图相关,第三节D中的路线图生成程序自动应用.

blocks.en: The final output consists of the root-to-stenosis path, path length, traversed bifurcations, branch angles, and left/right/straight navigation cues. These outputs can be overlaid with the guidewire-tip and stenosis predictions on the fluoroscopy image. No network training or manual landmark selection is performed during online inference.
blocks.zh: 最终的输出包括根到丝状的路径,路径长度,经过的双裂,分支角度,以及左/右/直角的导航提示. 这些输出可以用导线-提示和在氟镜图像上的速率预测来覆盖. 在在线推论期间,没有进行网络培训或手工地标选择。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setups
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据集

blocks.en: The simulated fluoroscopy dataset is generated from coronary CT angiography volumes of ImageCAS [ 23 ] using the procedure described in Section III-A. In total, 376 CT volumes are used, with four simulated projection views generated per volume, resulting in 1,504 images of size 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels. The split is performed at the CT-volume level to avoid anatomical overlap between sets: 208 volumes (832 images) are used for training, 84 volumes (336 images) for validation, and 84 volumes (336 images) for testing.
blocks.zh: 模拟的氟化物数据集是利用第三节A所述程序从ImageCAS[23]的冠状CT血管学卷中生成的。 总共使用了376个CT卷,每卷生成4个模拟投影视图,导致大小256×256256\time256像素的1 504幅图像. 拆分按CT卷进行,以避免各集之间的解剖重叠:208卷(832幅图像)用于培训,84卷(336幅图像)用于验证,84卷(336幅图像)用于测试.

blocks.en: Each image is accompanied by simulation-derived annotations including a binary vessel mask, guidewire-tip heatmap, and three stenosis landmarks corresponding to the proximal boundary, throat, and distal boundary. These annotations provide supervision for all perception tasks without manual fluoroscopy labeling.
blocks.zh: 每个图像都附有模拟产生的说明,包括一个二进制容器罩,导线-尖端热映射,以及三个与近缘边界,咽喉,底部边界相对应的速成地标. 这些说明对所有感知任务提供了监督,没有人工的氟化镜标注.

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en: MCP-Net uses DeepLabV3+ with a ResNet-50 backbone and 256 × 256 256\times 256 inputs. Training is performed for 40 epochs with batch size 4 using SGD ( lr = 5 × 10 − 3 \mathrm{lr}=5\times 10^{-3} , momentum 0.9 0.9 , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) and cosine annealing to 10 − 5 10^{-5} . The segmentation branch uses BCE+Dice loss, while the guidewire-tip and stenosis branches use DSNT-based localization losses with λ tip = λ sten = 5 \lambda_{\mathrm{tip}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{sten}}=5 .
blocks.zh: MCP-Net使用DeepLabV3+,并设有ResNet-50主干线和256×256256\times 256输入. 对40个批号为4的时代进行培训,使用SGD(lr = 5 × 10 − 3\mathrm{lr}=5\times 10^{-3},动力0.9 ,重量衰减10 − 4 10^{-4})和余弦反射10 − 5 10^{-5}。 分块分支使用BCE+Dice损失,而导线端点和速成分支则使用基于DSNT的本地化损失,其中QQ尖 = QQ sten = 5\lambda_{\mathrm{tip}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{sten}}=5 。 。 。

blocks.en: At inference, vessel probabilities are thresholded at 0.5, while landmark coordinates are recovered using an 11 × 11 11\times 11 local soft-argmax window. The predicted vessel mask is subsequently skeletonized and converted into a vascular graph, from which vessel connectivity, local caliber, and branch geometry are extracted. For the architecture comparison, DeepLabV3+ [ 27 ] , U-Net [ 28 ] , SegFormer [ 29 ] , and FPN [ 30 ] use identical multi-task heads, losses, data splits, and training schedules. All experiments were performed on an NVIDIA GB10 GPU with CUDA 13.0.
blocks.zh: 推论,船体概率阈值为0.5,而地标坐标则使用11×11 11\times 11本地软-argmax窗口进行回收. 预言的船面罩随后骨架化,转化为血管图,从中提取船体连接,局部口径,分支几何. 对于架构比较,DeepLabV3+[27],U-Net[28],SegFormer[29],FPN[30]使用相同的多任务头,损失,数据分割,以及训练时间表. 所有实验都是在配有CUDA 13.0的NVIDIA GB10 GPU上进行的.

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-C 评价计量

blocks.en: Vessel segmentation is evaluated using Dice, IoU, and centerline Dice (clDice). Guidewire-tip and stenosis-throat localization are evaluated using Euclidean pixel error, reported as median and interquartile range (IQR), together with PCK@5 and PCK@10. For stenosis localization, we additionally report the fraction of predicted throat points lying within the ground-truth lesion.
blocks.zh: 船舶分解使用Dice、IoU和中线Dice(ClDice)进行评估。 Guidewire-tip和stenosis-throat本地化使用Euclidean像素误差来评价,报告为中位值和方位值范围(IQR),连同PCK@5和PCK@10. 关于速成性局部化,我们另外报告地面-真实损伤中预计喉咙点的一小部分。

blocks.en: Lesion extent is evaluated using the absolute and relative error of the proximal-to-distal landmark distance. For the subset of stenosis predictions with throat error ≤ 8 \leq 8 pixels, we additionally report the median localization error. Computational efficiency is evaluated using the end-to-end latency and speed of the complete perception, topology, and roadmap pipeline.
V Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 五. 实验结果

blocks.en:
Table I summarizes the test-set performance of the final MCP-Net configuration using DeepLabV3+. For vessel segmentation, it achieved a Dice score of 90.3 ± 3.0 % 90.3\pm 3.0\% , an IoU of 82.5 ± 4.8 % 82.5\pm 4.8\% , and a clDice score of 96.0 ± 3.0 % 96.0\pm 3.0\% . The higher clDice relative to the region-overlap metrics indicates that the predicted masks
preserve the centerline structure of the coronary tree particularly well. This property is important for the subsequent skeletonization and graph construction, where discontinuities in thin vessel branches can directly affect the extracted vascular topology.

blocks.en: Guidewire-tip localization was accurate for most valid test samples, achieving a median error of 1.09 1.09 px (IQR: 0.73 0.73 – 1.95 1.95 px) and a PCK@5 of 88.1 % 88.1\% . The narrow IQR indicates that the majority of tip predictions are concentrated close to the ground-truth location. In comparison, stenosis-throat localization was more challenging, with a median error of 3.82 3.82 px (IQR: 1.88 1.88 – 27.1 27.1 px), PCK@5 of 52.7 % 52.7\% , and PCK@10 of 64.4 % 64.4\% . The considerably larger upper quartile indicates the presence of a subset of localization errors.
blocks.zh: Guidewire-tip本地化对于最有效的测试样本来说是准确的,实现了1.09 1.09 px(IQR:0.73 0.73–1.95 1.95 px)的中位误差,PCK@5为88.1%的88.1\%. 狭义的IQR表示,大部分尖端预测集中在接近地面真实位置的地方. 相比而言,stenosis-throat本地化更具挑战性,中位误差为3.82 3.82 px(IQR:1.88 1.88 – 27.1 27.1 px),PCK@5为52.7% 52.7\%,PCK@10为64.4% 64.4\%. 较大得多的上夸尔表示存在一个子集的本地化错误.

blocks.en: Despite this wider error distribution, 70.6 % 70.6\% of predicted throat locations fell within the ground-truth lesion extent. This suggests that some predictions identify the correct stenotic region without precisely localizing the lesion throat. For the subset of predictions with throat error ≤ 8 \leq 8 px, the median error decreased to 2.13 2.13 px (IQR: 1.29 1.29 – 3.23 3.23 px), showing substantially tighter localization among well-localized cases. The proximal and distal stenosis landmarks additionally provided an estimate of lesion extent. Across the valid lesion-length cases ( n = 316 n=316 ), the proximal-to-distal distance had a median absolute error of 4.60 4.60 px and a median relative error of 17.7 % 17.7\% .

For each test case, the input image and ground-truth vessel mask are followed by vessel-segmentation and guidewire-tip/stenosis localization predictions from DeepLabV3+, U-Net, SegFormer, and FPN.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 further illustrates the different localization behavior of the two tasks. Guidewire-tip accuracy rises rapidly at small pixel tolerances and then approaches a plateau, consistent with its relatively compact error distribution. In contrast, stenosis-throat localization improves more gradually as the tolerance increases, reflecting the broader error distribution observed in Table I . Together, these results indicate that guidewire-tip localization is the more stable of the two localization tasks, while precise identification of the stenosis throat remains more challenging.
blocks.zh: 图2进一步说明了两项任务的不同本地化行为. 在小像素容积下,导线-尖端精度迅速上升,然后接近一个高原,与其相对紧凑的误差分布一致. 相比之下,激素-喉部局部化随着耐受度的提高而逐步改善,反映了表一观察到的更广泛的误差分布. 这些结果表明,导线-尖端本地化在两个本地化任务中较为稳定,而精确识别齿喉仍然更具挑战性.

blocks.en: Table II compares DeepLabV3+, U-Net, SegFormer, and FPN using the same multi-task formulation and training conditions. DeepLabV3+ achieved the highest vessel-segmentation performance, with Dice, clDice, and IoU scores of 90.3 % 90.3\% , 96.0 % 96.0\% , and 82.5 % 82.5\% , respectively. It also obtained the lowest median guidewire-tip error ( 1.09 1.09 px) and stenosis-throat error ( 3.82 3.82 px), together with the lowest proportion of large throat-localization errors ( > 15 >15 px).
blocks.zh: 表二比较了DeepLabV3+,U-Net,SegFormer,FPN使用相同的多任务配制和培训条件. DeepLabV3+取得了最高的船段分数性能,Dice,ClDice和IoU的分数分别为90.3%90.3\%,96.0%96.0\%,82.5%82.5\%. 它还获得了最低的中位导线-尖端误差(1.09 1.09 px)和stenosis-throat误差(3.82 3.82 px),以及最大的喉-局部误差( > 15 > 15 px)的比例最低.

blocks.en: The alternative architectures showed different trade-offs. FPN produced the second-lowest guidewire-tip error ( 1.54 1.54 px), but showed the largest stenosis-throat error ( 8.97 8.97 px) and the highest proportion of errors above 15 px. U-Net was comparatively competitive for stenosis localization and achieved a slightly higher fraction of predictions within the ground-truth lesion than DeepLabV3+ ( 71.5 % 71.5\% versus 70.6 % 70.6\% ), although its median throat error remained higher ( 5.92 5.92 px). Considering both vessel segmentation and landmark localization performance, DeepLabV3+ was selected for the final MCP-Net configuration.
blocks.zh: 备选建筑表现出不同的权衡. FPN产生了第二低的导线-尖端误差(1.54 1.54 px),但显示了最大的stenosis-throat误差(8.97 8.97 px)和高于15 px的误差比例最高. U-Net在stensis本地化方面具有相对的竞争能力,在地面-真相损伤方面的预测比DeepLabV3+(71.5% 71.5\%对70.6% 70.6\%)稍高一点,尽管其喉误的中位数仍然较高(5.92 5.92 px). 考虑到船只分割和标志性本地化性能,DeepLabV3+被选入MCP-Net的最终配置.

blocks.en: The qualitative comparison in Fig. 3 is consistent with the quantitative results. The same fluoroscopy cases are processed by all four architectures, enabling direct comparison of vessel segmentation and landmark localization. Across the examples, DeepLabV3+ maintains the major vessel structure and thin branches more consistently, while also preserving the guidewire-tip and stenosis predictions required by the subsequent analysis. The comparison also illustrates that differences between architectures are not limited to pixel-wise vessel overlap, but can influence the vascular structure available for downstream graph extraction.
blocks.zh: 图3的定性比较与定量结果一致。 所有四个架构都处理同样的氟镜镜壳,从而可以直接比较船只的分割和地标化。 在整个例子中,DeepLabV3+保持了更一致的主要船体结构和细枝条,同时也保留了后续分析所需的导线-尖端和快感预测. 比较还表明,架构之间的差异不仅限于像素型容器重叠,而是可以影响可用于下游图提取的血管结构.

blocks.en: Beyond point localization, the MCP-Net outputs are associated with the predicted vessel geometry to obtain additional navigation-relevant information. Representative examples are shown in Fig. 4 . For the guidewire tip, the framework relates the predicted location to the vessel centerline and estimates the local vessel width. This analysis indicates whether the guidewire tip remains near the vessel centerline or deviates toward the vessel boundary, providing useful feedback for downstream guidewire navigation. For the stenosis, the proximal, throat, and distal landmarks provide estimates of lesion extent, throat diameter, and local reference diameter, and percentage diameter stenosis.
blocks.zh: 在点定位之外,MCP-Net的输出与预测的船几何相关,以获得更多的导航相关信息。 图4显示了代表性的例子。 对于导线尖端,框架将预计位置与船只中心线联系起来,并估计当地船只宽度. 这一分析表明导线尖端是否仍然靠近船只中心线或偏离船只边界,为下游导线导航提供了有益的反馈。 对于激素,近缘,咽喉,和底部地标提供了损伤程度,咽喉直径,以及局部参考直径,和百分比直径的激素估计.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 qualitatively demonstrates the vascular topology obtained from the predicted vessel masks. The centerline representation is converted into a graph containing the selected root, bifurcations, endpoints, and connecting vessel segments, while the graph edges retain local geometric information such as vessel caliber. The two examples show that the same processing pipeline can represent coronary trees with different branching complexity. This structured representation provides the connectivity and branch geometry required for the subsequent root-to-stenosis path analysis.
blocks.zh: 图5从质量上说明了从预测的容器口罩中获得的血管地形。 中心线表示法被转换成一个包含选定根,双联,端点,以及连接船段的图,而图边则保留船口径等局部几何信息. 这两个例子表明,同样的加工管道可以代表不同分支复杂性的冠状树. 这种结构化的表示方式提供了后续的根对丝质化路径分析所需的连通性和分支几何.

blocks.en: Finally, Fig. 6 demonstrates the complete perception-to-roadmap workflow. The predicted vessel representation and stenosis location are used to determine a root-to-target centerline path, while the traversed bifurcations are annotated with branch angles and left/right/straight navigation cues. The roadmap is displayed both on the simulated fluoroscopy image and on the extracted vessel representation, providing an interpretable output that combines the learned perception results with the subsequent geometric analysis.
blocks.zh: 最后,图6显示了完整的感知到行进图工作流程。 预测的船舶代表物和速成位置用于确定一个根对目标中线路径,而经过的双鱼则附加了分支角度和左/右/直角导航提示。 该路线图既显示在模拟的氟化物图像上,也显示在提取的船舶代表物上,提供了可解释的产出,将学到的感知结果与随后的几何分析结合起来。

blocks.en: The complete real-time pipeline, including MCP-Net inference, vascular topology extraction, and roadmap generation, achieved a mean end-to-end latency of 26.90 26.90 ms per frame, corresponding to 37.2 37.2 FPS on the NVIDIA GB10 platform. This demonstrates that the complete perception-to-roadmap pipeline can operate at real-time rates.
blocks.zh: 完整的实时管道,包括MCP-Net推导,血管地形提取,以及路线图生成,实现了每帧26.9026.90 ms的中间端到端延时,相当于NVIDIA GB10平台上的37.2 37.2 FPS. 这表明,完整的感知到路程图管道可以实时运行。

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Representative guidewire-tip and stenosis geometric analysis. Predicted landmarks are associated with the vessel geometry to estimate guidewire-tip position relative to the vessel, local vessel width, stenosis throat and reference diameters, lesion extent, and descriptive image-based percentage diameter stenosis (%DS).
blocks.zh: 费格。 4:具有代表性的导线-尖端和速感几何分析. 预测的地标与船只几何相关,用以估计导线-尖端相对于船只的位置、当地船只宽度、咽喉和参考直径、损伤程度以及描述性图像成比例直径尖端(%DS)。

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Representative vascular topology extracted from MCP-Net vessel predictions. The predicted mask is skeletonized and converted into a graph containing the automatically selected root, bifurcations, endpoints, and connecting vessel segments. Graph edges are color-coded according to their vessel diameter.
blocks.zh: 图5:从MCP-Net容器预测中提取的代表性血管地形。 预言的面具被骨架化,并转换成包含自动选择的根,双联,端点和连接船段的图. 图形边缘按其容器直径以颜色编码。

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Real-time roadmap visualization for two representative cases. The root-to-stenosis path is overlaid on the simulated fluoroscopy image (left) and predicted vessel mask (right), together with the guidewire tip, stenosis, start and end points, and bifurcation-level navigation cues.
blocks.zh: 费格。 6:两个代表性案例的实时路线图可视化. 在模拟的氟镜镜像(左)和预测的船面罩(右)上,加上导线尖,速成,起始点和终点,以及双福星级的导航提示,都覆盖了根至速成路径.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results show that MCP-Net can jointly recover vessel structure, guidewire-tip location, and stenosis information from a single simulated fluoroscopy frame. The high clDice score indicates good preservation of vessel connectivity, which is particularly important because missing or disconnected branches can directly affect the subsequent graph and navigation path. Guidewire-tip localization was robust, whereas stenosis localization exhibited a heavier error tail, indicating that precise lesion localization remains the more challenging perception task.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,MCP-Net可以联合回收船只结构,导线-提示位置,以及单个模拟氟放大架的速成信息. 高的ClDice分数表明船只连接性保存良好,这一点特别重要,因为缺失或断开的分支会直接影响后续的图和导航路径. 指南线-提示本地化很强,而快感本地化呈现出较重的误差尾巴,表明精确的损伤本地化仍然是更具挑战性的认知任务.

blocks.en: The proposed framework is particularly relevant to robotic-assisted interventions because it converts image-level predictions into an explicit vascular graph and target-oriented roadmap. Centerline-based representations have previously supported autonomous endovascular navigation [ 20 ] , while simulation has enabled guidewire-navigation strategies across varying vascular geometries [ 21 , 22 ] . Our framework complements these approaches by deriving vessel geometry, device location, and the target directly from fluoroscopic perception. Since simulation provides known anatomy, imaging geometry, and automatically generated supervision, the same principle could also be extended to other image-guided robotic procedures, such as TAVI or bronchoscopy, using task-specific anatomical representations.
blocks.zh: 拟议的框架与机器人辅助干预特别相关,因为它将图像层面的预测转化为明确的血管图和面向目标的路线图. 基于中线的表示方式以前曾支持自主内血管导航[20],而模拟则使得导线导航策略能够跨越不同的血管几何[21,22]. 我们的框架通过直接从荧光感知中得出容器几何、装置位置和目标来补充这些方法。 由于模拟提供了已知的解剖学,成像几何学,以及自动生成的监理,同样的原理也可以推广到其他的图像制导机器人程序,如TAVI或支气管扫描,使用任务特定的解剖表达.

blocks.en: The main limitation is that training and evaluation are currently restricted to simulated fluoroscopy. Although simulation enables controlled variation and exact geometric supervision, a domain gap to clinical images remains. Simulation-to-real approaches such as XA-Sim2Real [ 13 ] provide a possible direction for addressing this limitation. Future work will therefore focus on phantom and clinical validation, simulation-to-real adaptation, and integration of the generated roadmap with closed-loop robotic guidewire control.
blocks.zh: 主要限制是目前训练和评价仅限于模拟氟化物复制. 虽然模拟可以控制变异和精确的几何监督,但与临床图像仍有域间隙。 XA-Sim2Real [13] 等模拟-实际方法为处理这一限制提供了可能的方向。 因此,今后的工作将侧重于幻影和临床验证、模拟-实际适应以及将生成的路线图与闭路机器人导线控制相结合。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: This work presented a simulation-driven framework for real-time coronary perception, vascular topology analysis, and roadmap generation from X-ray fluoroscopy. MCP-Net jointly estimates the coronary vessel structure, guidewire-tip location, and target stenosis, while subsequent geometric processing transforms these predictions into an interpretable vascular graph and root-to-target navigation roadmap. Guidewire-tip localization additionally provides information about the current device position relative to the vessel centerline, which can support guiding the guidewire along the generated roadmap toward the target lesion. The results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating learned fluoroscopic perception with structured vascular reasoning to provide navigation-relevant information for robotic-assisted PCI.
blocks.zh: 这项工作提供了一个模拟驱动的框架,用于实时冠状感知、血管地形分析以及X射线荧光学生成路线图。 MCP-Net联合估算了冠状船体结构,导线-尖端位置,以及目标快感,而随后的几何处理将这些预测转化为可解释的血管图和根对目标导航路线图. Guidewire-tip本地化还提供了当前设备相对于船体中心线位置的信息,可以支持引导导线沿着生成的路线图向目标损伤方向前进. 研究结果表明,将所学的含氟感知与结构化血管推理结合起来,为机器人辅助PCI提供导航相关信息是可行的。
